parsed.explanation: State actors are the primary exposure: morality/indecency provisions actively enforced against gender-nonconforming people, with a recent quantified crackdown (84+ arrested, mainly trans women and gay men, Sep 2024–Jan 2025; mass convictions up to 4.5 years upheld on appeal Feb 2025). Forced anal examinations used as evidence, with refusal treated as guilt, persist despite a 2017 pledge — torture-adjacent severity applied by the state. Systemic identity refusal in detention records (Nov 2024) means custody compounds the harm: birth-name/birth-gender processing. No protections, remedies, or trans-specific recourse are documented; recognition is unsettled. This is tier-2 state-tolerated/directed targeting with severe penalties and failing recourse, recent and documented. Not execution-level, so above the 0.05 floor, but well below merely elevated risk.
